inputs.text: [serious] It was a carnivore. It hunted the big plant-eaters of its country — [confident] Edmontosaurus, and Saurolophus with its crest. [pauses] And maybe it didn't hunt alone: [amazed] scientists found 26 Albertosaurus together, in one spot.
[playful] That's exactly what scientists are trying to figure out. [mischievously] Maybe a real pack, like wolves today. [curious] They're still searching for the answer.
